description: This file defines a fragment for an Android app that manages two Floating Action Buttons (FABs). It inflates a layout containing the FABs, sets up change listeners on them, and logs their toggle state changes.

classes.name: FloatingActionButtonBasicFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that manages two Floating Action Buttons and handles their checked state changes.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's layout, initializes the FABs, and sets up listeners.

methods.name: onCheckedChanged
methods.description: Handles the checked state change events for the FABs, logging their current state.
